notes: Fixes 26 issues. Sessions opened between 00:00 and 01:00 no longer instantly auto-close (UTC stale-check bug), timestamps display in local time (no more 1-hour lag), and the register opening amount defaults to 0 instead of 10000. Clearing sales/purchase history no longer fails with a foreign key error, and the stats All filter shows real totals. Telegram toggles for product changes (price, quantity, name, barcode) are now in Settings. Cart lines gain eye (purchase cost) and pen (edit) buttons, the discount badge shows real values, purchase mode computes the estimated sale price from actual sale prices, held carts return in the mode they were held from, purchases reset the supplier after checkout, and line/unit counts appear on the cart, sales and purchase popups. Employee absences persist, advances reload correctly, and the employee page has search by name/code/job/RFID. Sales history reprints use the same professional 80mm receipt as the POS. Products, suppliers, sales and purchases tables get click-to-sort headers (asc/desc/default). Users can be pinned to the top of the login screen, password changes require the current password (TITAOU is the recovery master key), batch label printing scans-and-queues products for one print job, the unknown-barcode flow clears the search box, the login screen focuses the password field, and Windows 10 silent printing falls back to direct raster GDI printing instead of failing or flashing the Edge PDF window.
